fields.description: Save magic: ASCII 'turtles' + NUL, fills all of EEPROM block 0.
fields.evidence: FUN_08317324 reads EEPROM address 0 into RAM as 4x u16 (via DMA3 FUN_083172a4 to 0x0D000000); rev8-logical bytes 0..7 are 74 75 72 74 6C 65 73 00 in samples/baseline.sav.
fields.name: slot0_magic

fields.description: First payload word of EEPROM block 1 (slot 0); baseline value 0x0A00.
fields.evidence: FUN_08317324 decodes EEPROM block 1 (save offsets 8..15) as 4x u16 into RAM buffer offsets +0..+7 (ushort store at param_2+6 down to param_2+0); FUN_083173dc writes the same 4x ushort layout back. Baseline word verified.
fields.name: slot0_blk1_w0

fields.description: Second payload word of EEPROM block 1 (slot 0); baseline value 0x000A.
fields.evidence: FUN_08317324 decodes EEPROM block 1 (save offsets 8..15) as 4x u16 into RAM buffer; FUN_083173dc encodes 4x ushort per block on write. Baseline word verified.
fields.name: slot0_blk1_w1

fields.description: Third payload word of EEPROM block 1 (slot 0); baseline value 0x0001.
fields.evidence: FUN_08317324 decodes EEPROM block 1 (save offsets 8..15) as 4x u16 into RAM buffer; FUN_083173dc encodes 4x ushort per block on write. Baseline word verified.
fields.name: slot0_blk1_w2

fields.description: Fourth payload word of EEPROM block 1 (slot 0); baseline value 0x0000.
fields.evidence: FUN_08317324 decodes EEPROM block 1 (save offsets 8..15) as 4x u16 into RAM buffer; FUN_083173dc encodes 4x ushort per block on write. Baseline word verified.
fields.name: slot0_blk1_w3

fields.description: Slot 1 header block (EEPROM block 4); all zero in baseline = slot never claimed.
